title: CBI Digital Arrest
subtitle: A fake cyber-cell officer claims a digital arrest warrant is open in your name.

debrief_tips: No real CBI or police officer arrests someone over a phone call or WhatsApp video call.
Ask for the officer's name, department, and a written notice, then hang up and call the agency's official number.
Do not stay alone on a call that demands secrecy. Tell a family member immediately.
Never read out a code, ID, or number from your documents to an unexpected caller.
red_flags: pressure to stay on the call
synthetic_note: All names, case IDs, and amounts in this scenario are fictional.
